تقتادين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَادِينَ (taqtādīna) /taq.taː.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَادَ (iqtāda)
# تُقْتَادِينَ (tuqtādīna) /tuq.taː.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَادَ (iqtāda)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
